duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds (3-16)

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt for video generation, max 5000 characters. Refer to references by their position in the lists: [@reference_image_1], [@reference_image_2], ... for images and [reference_audio_1], [reference_audio_2], ... for audio clips.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the output video

reference_audio_urls.title: Reference Audio Urls
reference_audio_urls.description: URLs or base64 data URIs of up to 3 mp3 reference audio clips (3-12 seconds each, max 50 MB) used to keep voices consistent.

reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls
reference_image_urls.description: URLs or base64 data URIs of up to 12 reference images (png, jpeg, jpg, webp) used to keep subjects consistent.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Whether to generate audio (dialogue and sound effects) with the video. When false, the output video is silent.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

cover_image.description: Cover image of the generated video

video.description: The generated video from references using the Q4 Preview model
